title: Bounded maps: clock order and refused-charge entries (low)
evidence: (2) done: createQuotaCounter's charge refuses a charge over the whole limit before it touches the map (rate-limiter.ts charge, US-52 AC4i), and a new key's charge within the limit always fits its fresh count, so a refused charge leaves no entry. (1) left by owner ruling, 2026-11-26: boundedMap takes insertion order as expiry order, which holds while Date.now() never steps back. Scanning the whole map for an expired entry before each eviction would cost up to 50,000 steps per request at the bound; the one-use sets (US-52 AC16) only make room from expired entries, and the sweep clears the rest. Low priority. From the PR 1613 review
